overview: The Wausau Board of Public Works met on September 8th and approved a series of contractor pay estimates and project change orders totaling over $800,000 across multiple active city projects, including the downtown mall redevelopment, water treatment plant demolition, and asphalt paving. The board also approved masonry contractor licenses and moved into closed session to deliberate on claims.
presiding: Unknown — presiding officer not identified by name in the transcript

agenda.item: Call to order and review of August 25th Board of Public Works meeting minutes
Open bids — Pleasant View Park Ash timber harvest (Schreiber Logging)
2026 Sidewalk Repair Project A — Pembrooke Companies pay estimate #2 ($102,282.35)
2026 Asphalt Paving Project A — RC Pavers change order #2 ($354.38, crosswalk at Packer Drive)
2026 Asphalt Paving Project A — RC Pavers pay estimate #4 ($103,122.41)
2025 Water Treatment Plant Demo — MRD Group pay estimates #6 and #7 ($235,405.25 and $164,350)
2025 Downtown Mall Redevelopment Phase 2 — Pembrooke Companies pay estimate #9 ($233,403.56)
Portland Cement Concrete licenses for ABG Masonry and A1 Western Masonry
Motion to enter closed session per Wisconsin State Statute 19.85(1)(g) to deliberate on claims

discussions.body: A board member moved to approve the minutes and another seconded. The motion passed on a voice vote with all members voting aye. No discussion was recorded.

discussions.item: Pleasant View Park Ash Timber Harvest — Open Bid
discussions.body: One bid was received from Schreiber Logging. The board noted the bid would be reviewed by staff members identified as John and Jamie. No vote on award was recorded in this session.

discussions.item: 2026 Sidewalk Repair Project A — Pembrooke Companies Pay Estimate #2
discussions.body: A board member noted the work has been completed and moved to approve the payment of $102,282.35. The motion was seconded and passed unanimously on a voice vote.

discussions.item: 2026 Asphalt Paving Project A — RC Pavers Change Order #2
discussions.body: A board member, identified as John, explained that a crosswalk at Packer Drive had not been included in the original plan and a contractor was brought in to repaint it, resulting in a change order of $354.38. The motion to approve was made, seconded, and passed unanimously.

discussions.item: 2026 Asphalt Paving Project A — RC Pavers Pay Estimate #4
discussions.body: A board member moved to approve the pay estimate of $103,122.41. The motion was seconded and passed unanimously on a voice vote with no notable discussion.

discussions.item: 2025 Water Treatment Plant Demo — MRD Group Pay Estimates #6 and #7
discussions.body: The board approved two pay estimates totaling $399,755.25. A board member remarked that the site looks 'really different down there,' suggesting visible demolition progress. The motion passed unanimously.

discussions.item: 2025 Downtown Mall Redevelopment Phase 2 — Pembrooke Companies Pay Estimate #9
discussions.body: A board member explained this represents near-final quantities, with $10,000 in retainage held pending concrete sealing work expected to be completed before fall. Once sealing is done, the $10,000 will be released. The payment of $233,403.56 was approved unanimously.

discussions.item: Portland Cement Concrete Licenses — ABG Masonry and A1 Western Masonry
discussions.body: A board member, identified as John, stated he reviewed both license applications and bonds and moved to approve both. The motion was seconded and passed unanimously.
A board member moved to enter closed session pursuant to Wisconsin State Statute 19.85(1)(g) to deliberate on claims. The motion was seconded and passed unanimously on a voice vote.

actionItems: Staff (John and Jamie) to review the Schreiber Logging bid for Pleasant View Park Ash timber harvest
